title: Minister of Industry uses the production dialog
description: After a space dock is placed, the law's PRODUCTION window is the ordinary Produce units dialog (capacity, unit limits, payment) instead of a repeated single-unit list.

shots.heading: Before, desktop
shots.caption: Rules below 25: one generic 'produce one unit' question with a plain option list and no capacity, limits or batch; it came back once per unit.

shots.heading: After, desktop
shots.caption: Rules 25 and up: the same Produce units dialog as a tactical action, with the dock system's capacity, stats per unit and Done producing.

shots.heading: After, staged builds
shots.caption: Several units are staged in one batch, then paid with the standard planet payment step.

shots.heading: Before, phone (390 px)
shots.caption: The old list at phone width.

shots.heading: After, phone (390 px)
shots.caption: The production dialog in one column.

notes.title: Rule.
notes.text: Minister of Industry: when the owner places a space dock in a system, their units in that system may use their PRODUCTION abilities. Only the dock system, only after a space dock (not a PDS).

notes.title: Engine.
notes.text: The change is engine-side (RULES_MINISTER_INDUSTRY_WINDOW = 25): the law now asks the ordinary produce_unit question, which the client already renders as the builder. No web code changed.

notes.title: Fixtures.
notes.text: Synthetic mocked game with the choice shapes the engine emits before and after; not an engine capture.
